title: Group epoch: reject int/str master_secret (bytes(int) yields silent all-zero key)
description: Robustness review finding on worker6-9mkj.1. group_oscore_epoch.py:98,145: bytes(master_secret) converts an int to an all-zero secret of that length (GroupEpochManager('g', 32) -> 32 zero bytes; rekey(16) -> 16 zero bytes; probe-confirmed). A silent zero key in a crypto module is catastrophic-but-quiet. Sister wrap module rejects non-bytes at its boundary; epoch does not. Fix: reject non-bytes-like input (at minimum int) before bytes() in __init__ and rekey, raising ValueError per the docstring (str currently raises TypeError from bytes(), also inconsistent with docstring).
